source_caption_text:
How I genuinely expect my hg to describe me to her fine ahh friends 😭🔥

GloRilla jumps on the remix of BossMan Dlow’s “Shake Dat A** (Twerk Song)” with a verse that fits right into the track’s club sound. Her raspy delivery and confident bars give the remix a different feel while keeping the same energy as the original.

Her verse touches on money, relationships and attraction, with GloRilla keeping things direct and letting the punchlines carry the verse. She brings her own style to the track without making it feel disconnected from BossMan Dlow’s part.

The remix brought GloRilla into one of BossMan Dlow’s biggest party records, giving the song another standout verse. Her part quickly became one of the most talked-about moments from the remix.
